mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart (user_id, goods_id, goods_spec, unit, quantity, is_checked, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{goodsId}, #{goodsSpec}, #{unit}, #{quantity}, #{isChecked}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY is_checked DESC, create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE cart SET is_checked = #{isChecked} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_checked = 1
